title: Precision Farming & Crop Analytics
thesis: Snowflake ingests field sensor data, analyzes crop imagery with multimodal AI, forecasts yields and harvest timing, and alerts agronomists — replacing fragmented farm management with unified precision agriculture

talking_points: Predicted harvest yield at 94% of target across 2,400 blocks — ฿280M potential shortfall.
Twenty-three percent of rice blocks showing moisture stress in Isaan region (drought risk).
ML.FORECAST accuracy: 87% within 10% of actual yield at 60 days before harvest.
show: Point at yield vs target KPI gauge
tabs.call_out: ฿280M yield shortfall risk — 23% of blocks moisture-stressed

transition.line: Let's drill into which fields need intervention.

talking_points: Cortex Complete (multimodal) analyzes 15,000 crop images — detecting blast disease in rice Block-47.
NDVI trend for Block-47 declining 18% over 3 weeks — confirms visual detection.
AI classifies: 'Rice blast (Pyricularia oryzae) — moderate severity, 2.3 hectares affected.'
show: Show crop imagery with AI annotations
tabs.call_out: Multimodal AI detects disease from imagery — confirmed by NDVI

transition.line: How does this affect our yield forecast?

talking_points: ML.FORECAST generates per-block yield predictions 90 days before harvest.
Sugarcane in Eastern region: predicted 8% above target — strong monsoon benefit.
Rice in Isaan: 12% below target due to moisture stress — irrigation intervention recommended.
show: Show yield forecast dashboard by crop and region
tabs.call_out: 90-day yield predictions at block level — 87% accuracy

transition.line: Now let the CAO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Suraphon asks: 'What's the yield shortfall by crop and what interventions can close the gap?'
Cortex Analyst: Rice -12% (฿180M), Mango -8% (฿60M), Sugarcane +8%. Irrigation can recover 60% of rice gap.
Switch to advisor: 'What's the irrigation investment vs yield recovery ROI?' — generates cost-benefit analysis.
show: Type: 'Yield shortfall by crop with intervention options'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + agronomic advisory

talking_points: Eight Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
IoT Core streams 1.5M sensor readings; SageMaker/Cortex Complete analyzes imagery; ML.FORECAST predicts yields.
Thai agriculture: ฿1.4T industry employing 12M people. This manages 85 farms, 2,400 blocks.
tabs.call_out: Sensor + satellite + imagery — precision farming on one platform

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Thai precision agriculture.
